PlatformModulesSection.title: How SEDES supports territorial planning and management

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.description: Brings together official layers on drought, climate, vegetation and socioeconomic conditions to follow the territory over time.

communication.title: Communication
communication.description: Generates automatic PDF reports by variable and scale (Brazil, state or municipality) to share the situation of the territory.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.description: Combines indicators in a multi-criteria analysis with configurable weights to identify priority areas and guide strategies in the territory.
